name: Netherlands
marketContext: The Netherlands is our home market — VISUAILS is based in Enschede, and Dutch brands selling through Bol.com and Shopify make up a core part of our client base.
whyRemoteWorks: No remote gap at all: Dutch clients are in the same timezone and often the same working hours as our studio team, with same-day calls and revisions the norm.
localFact: Bol.com's image guidelines are strict about background and framing consistency — our catalog-image process is built with those specs in mind by default for Dutch sellers.
